activities.name: Trolltunga
activities.note: outside the summer window a certified guide is compulsory, so the hike is bookable rather than shut

windows.reason: the main season — experienced hikers may go unguided from 1 June, and the trail is clear of snow with very long daylight
still walkable unguided to the end of the month, with shorter days and colder weather
a hiking guide is compulsory from 1 October to 31 May

activities.name: Northern lights
activities.note: not a thing that closes — in the summer months the sky simply never gets dark enough, whatever the sun is doing

windows.reason: the darkest, longest nights of the season, with viewing strongest roughly 21:00 to 02:00
the season runs September to April; October and November are statistically among the strongest for activity, and March pairs dark evenings with enough snow for husky and snowmobile trips
the tail of the season, as the nights shorten
